text: Uses only the Python standard library
Takes a target directory to organize
Moves files into subdirectories named by file extension
--watch mode: keep watching the directory and organize newly appearing files
Skip files already in subdirectories (non-recursive, top-level only)
Does not move its own log file organizer.log (implied: log must not be organized away / break logging)
Handles files without extension sensibly (no crash, deterministic destination or skip)
Does not overwrite/lose data on name collision in destination (implied by safe file moving)
